name: Inter-reflection Modeling
definition: A technique to model indirect illumination by tracing a ray from a surface point in the reflective direction to a secondary intersection point, computing its radiance, and blending it into the primary point's output to account for inter-reflections.
summary: Inter-reflection Modeling approximates indirect illumination by tracing a single ray to a secondary intersection point, accommodating non-collocated camera and light setups unlike prior methods.
